campaigns.request: Original inclusive beauty-editorial close portrait of a fictional adult Black model, berry lip and copper/plum eye detail, warm-white studio, professional beauty styling, fully appropriate editorial crop, no real celebrity/brand logo/text. Image is illustrative, not a virtual try-on or prediction.

Original beauty-editorial portrait of a fictional adult androgynous model with light freckled skin, graphic plum eye and natural rose lip, a deliberate burgundy/white composition, no real celebrity/brand logo/text. Illustrative editorial only.
Tactile macro still life of berry/coral/plum/gold cosmetic pigment smears and powder on warm-white paper, expressive original composition, no text or logo.

mediaContract: 10 unique closed neutral packaging photos, 3 canonical open Satin Stroke shade photos, 3 campaign images =16 assets, full+small local WebP variants.

Use the canonical closed Satin Stroke container as reference for the three open matching shade photos. Closed opaque packages are genuinely shade-neutral; do not display a visibly mismatched pigment as a selected shade.
Photos do not predict colour on skin; UI shade names and selected states remain visible, with illustrative swatch labeling.
All new assets original, no copied private/client/photos from previous brands. Separate built-in ImageGen call per asset, optimize delivery and record exact prompts/masters/final dimensions/hashes.
lookBuilder: Build a COLOUR STORY, not a skin match: choose one compatible lips, eyes and complexion-accent variant from fixture look tags.
Tint shades have no default skin matching; the builder may use blush/highlighter accents. No camera, biometric inference or virtual try-on claim.

Sum current selected prices in integer cents. Removing a slot recomputes total. Atomic add-look validates all stock/variant rules and variant-merges with existing cart, without partial silent changes.
